main_text.l: EXERC. XVI.
UTRUM PARTIS SIMULA-
ris materia per se ullis possit af-
fligi morbis?
Jam uero ad illos materiae partis fimila-
ris morbos, quos ipse Fernelius libro de
Abditis rerum caufis fecundo, capite no-
no, & de Morborum differentiis, capite fe-
ptimo tanquam nouos & inauditos suo iu-
re statuit, progredi tempestiuum est. Hi au-
tem sunt durities, mollities, crassities, te-
nuitas, densitas, astrictio & laxitas, quos o-
mnes immoderationis materiae partis simi-
laris constituit. Verum rationes, quibus hu-
iusmodi morbos confirmare conatur, pro-
ducere & simul examinare nobis cōuenit:
quarum prima est partium similariū actio-
nes posse laedi sano temperamento: altera,
multorum hominum uentriculos nec ace-
tum ferre, neq; sinapi. Tertia, nonnullos
quibusdam odoribus supra modū aut de-
lectari, aut offendi: quarta, morbos uentri-
culi, & hepatis astringentia perpetuò
postulare: Postrema, immoderate laxantia ui-
res diffoluere. Quod ad primam attinet, il-
lam diluere operosum non erit. Nullius

page.notes: Printed "neq;" and "namq;" kept as printed. Marginal note numerals on the right are partly faint: "ii.", "iij.", "iv." are uncertain readings. The last margin mark is unreadable. The small ornaments (») at line ends are not transcribed as text. Long s normalised to s; u/v and i/j normalised per the rules (VTRVM to UTRUM, SIMVLA to SIMULA, fimilaris to similaris, Iam to Jam). The drop-cap I is joined to the first word. Printed "s" forms in the word "fimila-ris" are rendered as s. Printed "durities" and "pro-ducere" text is copied as seen; a hyphen at the end of "pro-" and "tempestiuum est" line breaks is handled as printed.
